strings.name: Tom Cruise
strings.summary: Cruise moved from youth films into drama and action, building a lasting screen identity through Top Gun and Mission: Impossible. As a producer he has supported demanding practical stunts and theatrical releases, while exploring complex characters with different directors. He received an honorary Oscar in 2025, distinct from a competitive award. His Scientology advocacy and statements against psychiatry have caused controversy.

strings.influence.rationale: By starring in and producing films such as Mission: Impossible over many years, he has influenced the global commercial film industry through action production and theatrical distribution practices.
